interpretation: 110 of 198 predicted GDSC2 drug responses were associated with MPCDS at BH FDR < 0.05; 59 indicated greater predicted sensitivity with higher MPCDS and 51 indicated greater predicted resistance.
104 predicted drug responses differed between PCD_C1 and PCD_C2 at BH FDR < 0.05; 38 had lower predicted IC50 in PCD_C2 and 66 had higher predicted IC50 in PCD_C2.
72 unambiguous drugs were testable in both GDSC2 and PRISM.
37 of 72 testable matched drugs were directionally concordant (51.4%); concordance did not exceed chance expectation.
GDSC2 and PRISM MPCDS effect sizes showed negligible correlation (Spearman rho = -0.090, p = 0.453).
No GDSC2 FDR-significant matched drug also reached nominal PRISM p < 0.05.
GDSC2/oncoPredict findings therefore represent in silico drug-sensitivity hypotheses rather than independently validated therapeutic-response biomarkers.
